61839-the-wreck-of-the-corsaire.title: The Corsaire
61839-the-wreck-of-the-corsaire.creator: W. Clark Russell
61839-the-wreck-of-the-corsaire.description: A book by W. Clark Russell. One I had made to Sydney and Melbourne, and a second to China; and now I was bound to Bombay with some kind of notion beyond of striking across into Persia, thence to Arabia, and so home by way of the classic shores of the Mediterranean.

arxiv-2003-06549.title: Interpreting and Stabilizing Machine-learning Parametrizations of Convection
arxiv-2003-06549.creator: Noah D. Brenowitz, Tom Beucler, Michael Pritchard, Christopher S. Bretherton
arxiv-2003-06549.description: Abstract Neural networks are a promising technique for parameterizing sub-grid-scale physics (e.g. moist atmospheric convection) in coarse-resolution climate models, but their lack of interpretability and reliability prevents widespread adoption. For instance, it is not fully understood why neural network parameterizations often cause dramatic instability when coupled to atmospheric fluid dynamics.

arxiv-2106-03753.title: Energy-Efficient Naming in Beeping Networks Volume: 178 Issue: 1
arxiv-2106-03753.creator: Ny Aina Andriambolamalala, Vlady Ravelomanana
arxiv-2106-03753.description: Abstract A single-hop beeping network is a distributed communication model in which all stations can communicate with one another by transmitting only 1 − b ​ i ​ t 1-bit messages, called beeps. This paper focuses on resolving the distributed computing area’s two fundamental problems: naming and counting problems.

arxiv-2109-06933.title: Measuring tau neutrino appearance probability via unitarity
arxiv-2109-06933.creator: Ivan Martinez-Soler, Hisakazu Minakata
arxiv-2109-06933.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ivan Martinez-Soler, Hisakazu Minakata. We propose a unitarity method for determining τ \tau neutrino appearance probability P ⁡ ( ν μ → ν τ ) P(\nu_{\mu}\rightarrow\nu_{\tau}) in long-baseline (LBL) accelerator experiments and atmospheric neutrino observations.

arxiv-2209-08697.title: Quantifying How Hateful Communities Radicalize Online Users
arxiv-2209-08697.creator: Matheus Schmitz, Goran Muric, Keith Burghardt
arxiv-2209-08697.description: Abstract While online social media offers a way for ignored or stifled voices to be heard, it also allows users a platform to spread hateful speech. Such speech usually originates in fringe communities, yet it can spill over into mainstream channels.

arxiv-2212-12881.title: Superfluidity from correlations in driven boson systems
arxiv-2212-12881.creator: Jesús Mateos, Charles Creffield, Fernando Sols
arxiv-2212-12881.description: Abstract We investigate theoretically the superfluidity of a one-dimensional boson system whose hopping energy is periodically modulated with a zero time average, which results in the suppression of first-order single-particle hopping processes. The dynamics of this Floquet-engineered flat-band system is entirely driven by correlations and described by exotic Hamiltonian and current operators.

arxiv-2305-08902.title: Classical Dynamics of Vortex Solitons from Perturbative Scattering Amplitudes
arxiv-2305-08902.creator: Callum R. T. Jones
arxiv-2305-08902.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Callum R. T. Jones. We introduce a novel point-particle effective description of ANO vortex solitons in the critical Abelian Higgs Model (AHM) in d = 2 + 1 d=2+1 based on the small winding expansion. Identifying the effective vortices with the elementary quanta of a complex scalar field, relativistic vortex-vortex scattering amplitudes are calculated as a diagrammatic, perturbative expansion in the winding number N N .

arxiv-2307-07008.title: Inequities and misaligned expectations in PhD students’ search for a research group
arxiv-2307-07008.creator: Mike Verostek (he/him), Casey W. Miller (he/him), Benjamin M. Zwickl (he/him)
arxiv-2307-07008.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mike Verostek (he/him), Casey W. Miller (he/him), Benjamin M. Zwickl (he/him). Joining a research group is one of the most important events on a graduate student’s path to earning a PhD, but the ways students go about searching for a group remain largely unstudied. It is therefore crucial to investigate whether departments are equitably supporting students as they look for an advisor, especially as students today enter graduate school with more diverse backgrounds than ever before.

arxiv-2308-04932.title: Exploring Ligand-to-Metal Charge-transfer States in the Photo-Ferrioxalate System using Excited-State Specific Optimization
arxiv-2308-04932.creator: Lan Nguyen Tran, Eric Neuscamman
arxiv-2308-04932.description: Abstract The photo-ferrioxalate system (PFS), [Fe(III)(C 2 O 4 )] 3- , more than an exact chemical actinometer, has been extensively applied in wastewater and environment treatment. Despite many experimental efforts to improve clarity, important aspects of the mechanism of ferrioxalate photolysis are still under debate.

arxiv-2309-06108.title: Baxter Q Q -operators in Ruijsenaars-Sutherland hyperbolic systems: one- and two-particle cases
arxiv-2309-06108.description: Abstract In these notes we review the technique of Baxter Q Q -operators in the Ruijsenaars-Sutherland hyperbolic systems in the cases of one and two particles. Using these operators we show in particular that eigenfunctions of these systems admit two dual integral representations and prove their orthogonality and completeness. N. Belousov † , S. Derkachov † , S.

arxiv-2310-10105.title: Stochastic 1d Burgers equation as a model for hydrodynamical turbulence.
arxiv-2310-10105.creator: Sergei Kuksin
arxiv-2310-10105.description: Abstract . This work is a review with proofs of a group of results on the stochastic Burgers equation with small viscosity, obtained during the last two decades. These results jointly show that the equation makes a surprisingly good model of hydrodynamical turbulence.

arxiv-2311-10720.title: Cryptocurrency in the Aftermath: Unveiling the Impact of the SVB Collapse
arxiv-2311-10720.creator: Qin Wang ∗ , Guangsheng Yu ∗ , Shiping Chen ∗
arxiv-2311-10720.description: Abstract . In this paper, we explore the aftermath of the Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) collapse, with a particular focus on its impact on crypto markets. We conduct a multi-dimensional investigation, which includes a factual summary, analysis of user sentiment, and examination of market performance.

arxiv-2410-18685.title: Gate Efficient Composition of Hamiltonian Simulation and Block-Encoding with its Application on HUBO , Chemistry and Finite Difference Method
arxiv-2410-18685.creator: Robin OLLIVE, Stephane LOUISE
arxiv-2410-18685.description: Abstract The basic appendix shows calculation details and quantum circuit construction by direct applications, allowing notation clarifications. The annex is more foccussed on the formalism than the initial paper; it aims to show the natural consequences of the associated paper such as the measurement of expectation values with fewer observables.

arxiv-2411-07994.title: Search for the X17 particle in Li 7 ​ ( p , e + ​ e − ) 8 ​ Be {}^{7}\mathrm{Li}(\mathrm{p},\mathrm{e}^{+}\mathrm{e}^{-})^{8}\mathrm{Be} processes with the MEG II detector.
arxiv-2411-07994.creator: The MEG II collaboration K. Afanaciev addr12, A. M. Baldini addr1 a, S. Ban addr10, H. Benmansour addr1 ab e1, G. Boca addr4 ab, P. W. Cattaneo addr4 a, G. Cavoto addr5 ab e1, F. Cei addr1 ab, M. Chiappini addr1 ab, A. Corvaglia addr6 a, G. Dal Maso addr2,addr16, A. De Bari addr4 a, M. De Gerone add
arxiv-2411-07994.description: Abstract The observation of a resonance structure in the opening angle of the electron-positron pairs in the 7 Li(p,e + e - ) 8 Be reaction was claimed and interpreted as the production and subsequent decay of a hypothetical particle (X17).

arxiv-2502-05827.title: HyGEN : Regularizing Negative Hyperedge Generation for Accurate Hyperedge Prediction
arxiv-2502-05827.creator: Song Kyung Yu, Da Eun Lee, Yunyong Ko, Sang-Wook Kim
arxiv-2502-05827.description: Abstract . Hyperedge prediction is a fundamental task to predict future high-order relations based on the observed network structure. Existing hyperedge prediction methods, however, suffer from the data sparsity problem. To alleviate this problem, negative sampling methods can be used, which leverage non-existing hyperedges as contrastive information for model training.

arxiv-2504-14676.title: Analysis of Stochastic Fluid-Rigid Body Dynamics: an Approach by Stochastic Maximal Regularity
arxiv-2504-14676.creator: Felix Brandt, Arnab Roy
arxiv-2504-14676.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Felix Brandt, Arnab Roy. This paper investigates for the first time a rigorous mathematical framework for a stochastic fluid-rigid body interaction problem. It is shown that the coupled problem of a rigid ball immersed in a Newtonian fluid filling the entire ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} and subject to additive noise in the fluid and rigid body equation as well as transport noise in the fluid equation is locally strongly well-posed. In addition, blow-up criteria for the stochastic fluid-rigid body interaction problem are provided.

arxiv-2507-07680.title: Temporal modulation of second harmonic generation in ferroelectrics by a pulsed electric field
arxiv-2507-07680.creator: Atsushi Ono
arxiv-2507-07680.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Atsushi Ono. We revisit the relationship between electric polarization modulation Δ ​ P \Delta P in ferroelectrics induced by a low-frequency pulsed electric field and the corresponding second harmonic intensity modulation Δ ​ I SH \Delta I_{\mathrm{SH}} . Using nonlinear response theory, we derive their time-domain expressions linear in the pulse amplitude, revealing that not only the electric field but also its time derivative contributes to Δ ​ I SH \Delta I_{\mathrm{SH}} .

arxiv-2507-17076.title: Dynamical and Emission Properties of Quantum Emitters driven by Ultra-Short Laser Pulses
arxiv-2507-17076.creator: Juan E. Ardila-García, Juan S. Sierra-Jaraba, Herbert Vinck-Posada
arxiv-2507-17076.description: Abstract The development of high-performance quantum technologies relies on the ability to prepare the quantum states of solid-state emitters with high fidelity while cleanly separating the emitted photons from the driving field. Here, we present a comprehensive theoretical comparison of three single-pulse coherent control protocols: resonant Rabi oscillations, adiabatic rapid passage (ARP), and notch-filtered ARP (NARP).

arxiv-2601-09359.title: Field report from Collaborative Research Center 1625: Heterogeneous research data management using ontology representations
arxiv-2601-09359.description: Abstract The goal of the Collaborative Research Center 1625 is the establishment of a scientific basis for the atomic-scale understanding and design of multifunctional compositionally complex solid solution surfaces. Next to materials synthesis in form of thin-film materials libraries, various materials characterization and simulations techniques are used to explore the materials data space of the problem.

pmc-10562925.title: Assessment of human health hazard associated with heavy metal accumulation in popular freshwater, coastal and marine fishes from south-west region, Bangladesh
pmc-10562925.creator: Anusree Biswas, Kaniz Fatema Kanon, Md Anisur Rahman, Mohammad Shafiqul Alam, Sudipta Ghosh, Md Almamun Farid
pmc-10562925.description: An analysis was conducted on both freshwater, coastal and marine fish species to evaluate the concentrations of heavy metals, with the aim of assessing their levels and examining the potential health risks for humans linked to the consumption of contaminated fish.

pmc-10598928.title: Development of an eco-friendly HPLC method for the stability indicating assay of binary mixture of ibuprofen and phenylephrine
pmc-10598928.creator: Khadiga M. Kelani, Yasmin M. Fayez, Ahmed M. Abdel-Raoof, Reham A. Fekry, Said A. Hassan
pmc-10598928.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The development and validation of the stability indicating HPLC technique has contributed to the understanding of the stability profile of ibuprofen (IBU) and phenylephrine (PHE). Stability profile was achieved for PHE; the drug was found to be liable to be influenced by stress oxidative conditions; two oxidative degradants (Deg1 & Deg2) were formed and their structures were confirmed using IR and mass spectrometry.

pmc-10673034.title: Tolerated Re-Challenge of Immunotherapy in a Patient with ICI Associated Myocarditis: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-10673034.creator: Walid Shalata, Zoé Gabrielle Attal, Rajeh Shhadi, Amjad Abu Salman, Ashraf Abu Jama, Sondos Shalata, Kais Halumi, Alexander Yakobson, Vikash Jaiswal, Monodeep Biswas
pmc-10673034.description: Many different types of cancer can be treated with immunotherapy drugs called immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). These drugs have altered the landscape of cancer treatment options since they function by triggering a stronger immune response to malignancy. As expected, ICIs’ modification of immune regulatory controls leads to a wide range of organ/gland-specific immune-related side effects.

pmc-10718845.title: Retracted: Music Intervention to Orthopedic Patients: A Possible Alternative Solution to Control Pain
pmc-10718845.creator: Computational and Mathematical Methods in Medicine
pmc-10718845.description: that this notice is intended solely to alert readers that the peer-review process of this article has been compromised. Wiley and Hindawi regret that the usual quality checks did not identify these issues before publication and have since put additional measures in place to safeguard research integrity.

pmc-11283397.title: A novel Saclayvirus Acinetobacter baumannii phage genomic analysis and effectiveness in preventing pneumonia
pmc-11283397.creator: Shibin Li, Bingdong Wei, Le Xu, Cong Cong, Bilal Murtaza, Lili Wang, Xiaoyu Li, Jibin Li, Mu Xu, Jiajun Yin, Yongping Xu
pmc-11283397.description: Acinetobacter baumannii, which is resistant to multiple drugs, is an opportunistic pathogen responsible for severe nosocomial infections. With no antibiotics available, phages have obtained clinical attention. However, since immunocompromised patients are often susceptible to infection, the appropriate timing of administration is particularly important. During this research, we obtained a lytic phage vB_AbaM_P1 that specifically targets A. baumannii.

pmc-11462237.title: Protocol for developing an explosion-propeller hybrid driving underwater robot for AI-based concrete overhaul in real marine environments
pmc-11462237.creator: Chenjie Zhang, Zhaochang Chen, Pengcheng Jiao
pmc-11462237.description: SummaryWe recently developed an explosion-propeller hybrid driving underwater robot combined with an AI-based concrete damage detection technique for concrete overhaul in real marine environments. Here, we describe steps for establishing a detection dataset, optimizing and testing the algorithm, and preparing the explosive module. We detail procedures for setting up the robot body, assembling, and preparing other tools.

pmc-11463065.title: Impact of systemic steroids on the efficacy of first line imatinib treatment of patients with advanced gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs)
pmc-11463065.creator: Sejin Kim, Hyung-Don Kim, Eo Jin Kim, Min-Hee Ryu, Yoon-Koo Kang
pmc-11463065.description: BackgroundEffective management of adverse events is required to maintain sufficient imatinib dosing when treating patients with gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs). Skin rash is a common adverse event of imatinib, which can be effectively controlled by systemic steroid treatment without imatinib dose modification or interruption.

pmc-12563209.title: Molecular Analysis of Cerebrospinal Fluid Tumor-Derived DNA to Aid in the Diagnosis and Targeted Treatment of Breast Cancer Brain Metastasis
pmc-12563209.creator: Michael Youssef, Alexandra Larson, Vindhya Udhane, Viriya Keo, Kala F Schilter, Qian Nie, Honey V Reddi, Shun-Fa Yang
pmc-12563209.description: A woman in her 40s with a history of ER/PR+, HER2-negative breast cancer presented with a seizure three years after mastectomy. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed a right caudate head mass, which was concerning for either high-grade glioma or metastatic disease, but biopsy was deemed too high risk.

pmc-12744723.title: Cutting edge developments in bone oncology – Highlights from the Cancer and Bone Society 2024 annual meeting
pmc-12744723.creator: Deanna N Edwards, Shreya Patel, Gabriel M Pagnotti
pmc-12744723.description: Highlights•The Cancer and Bone Society (CABS) serves as a global hub for cancer and bone research, uniting basic scientists and clinicians.•Sessions showcased molecular and clincial breakthroughs, illustrating the transational applicability to patient care.•Emerging work revealed the ciritical role of the bone microenvironment in metastasis and therapeutic resistance.

pmc-13088828.title: Implementing youth advisory boards with sexual minority adolescents and young men: sharing experiences, challenges and opportunities from East, South, and West Africa
pmc-13088828.creator: Sylvia Adebajo, Taylor Lascko, Marie-Claude C Lavoie, Akipu Ehoche, Chester Mutumba, Nicholas Shima Aernan, Nathan Nganga, Benson Njoroge, Philip Daniel Chinseu, Richard Gichuki, Olawole Ayorinde, Ojore Godday Aghedo, Kennedy Sambambi, Gift Ndalumbira, Maria Chinoko Ngulube, John Chama, Elizabeth Sh
pmc-13088828.description: Clinical trials involving sexual minority adolescents and young men in low- and middle-income countries have historically been limited due to a combination of structural, social, and scientific barriers that often hinder their participation. In addition, researchers lack the cultural competence or knowledge of inclusive recruitment strategies to effectively engage these populations.

pmc-13113221.title: Gestural Sequences in Wild Spider Monkeys (Ateles geoffroyi)
pmc-13113221.creator: Eva Corral, Sara Cardoso Rodriguez, Katja Liebal, Miquel Llorente, Federica Amici
pmc-13113221.description: To date, research on gestural communication in species other than great apes has been quite limited, especially in their natural habitat, although including a broader range of species in different settings is essential for identifying evolutionary patterns and determining whether some of the fundamental characteristics of human communication are widely shared across primates.

pmc-13215965.title: Nanobody targeting glycan cap confers broad orthoebolavirus neutralization
pmc-13215965.creator: Xinhui Zhang, Yi Liao, Xiuying Liu, Jingya Zhou, Peixiang Gao, Xuemeng Dong, Shengnan Pan, Huarui Duan, Junyu Liu, Xiaojing Chi, Wei Yang
pmc-13215965.description: The Zaire Ebola virus (EBOV) and Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) cause severe hemorrhagic fever with high mortality, highlighting the urgent need for broad-spectrum antiviral therapies. Neutralizing nanobodies, with their small size, structural stability, and ability to access sterically restricted epitopes, represent a promising antiviral modality.

pmc-13393278.title: Integration of Reconfigurable p‐Bit and 1R Crossbar Array for Memristive Probabilistic Computing
pmc-13393278.creator: Keunho Soh, Ji Eun Kim, Suk Yeop Chun, Su In Hwang, Byung Seok Kim, Young Jae Lee, Ho Won Jang, Jung Ho Yoon

pmc-13574730.title: Extending standardized speech analysis across languages: An Italian toolkit for transcription and coding of neurological speech
pmc-13574730.creator: Allegra Benzini, Alyssa M Lanzi, Cinzia Palmirotta, Simona Aresta, Petronilla Battista, Gaia C Santi
pmc-13574730.description: Speech and language analysis plays a central role in assessing adult neurological disorders, providing sensitive markers across clinical populations to support diagnosis. Standardized transcription and coding systems are essential to ensure reproducible analyses and enable comparisons across studies and languages. However, practical guidance on adapting such systems for non-English speakers remains limited.
